stories.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle Resigns as US Ambassador to Greece Amid Misconduct Allegations
stories.summary: Kimberly Guilfoyle has resigned from her position as the U.S. ambassador to Greece following allegations of misconduct, including claims that she solicited a Trump donor to pay off her credit card debt in exchange for political access. President Trump confirmed her resignation, expressing dissatisfaction with the situation. Guilfoyle has stated that she will vigorously defend herself against the allegations.

stories.title: Pope Leo Undergoes Successful Lung Surgery to Remove Nodule
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV has successfully undergone surgery to remove a nodule from his lung, as confirmed by the Vatican. The procedure was completed as planned, and the growth was detected at an early stage. Following the surgery, the Pope is expected to remain in the hospital for a week, during which all his public audiences have been canceled.

stories.title: Bryan Cranston Pays Tribute to RJ Mitte Following His Death at 34
stories.summary: Bryan Cranston expressed deep sorrow over the death of his 'Breaking Bad' co-star RJ Mitte, who passed away at the age of 34. Cranston referred to Mitte as 'my sweet son' and revealed they had been planning to meet for lunch shortly before his death. Mitte's representative confirmed that he died by suicide at his home in Brownsville, Texas.

stories.summary: Katie Zacharia, the new White House press secretary, conducted her first media briefing, which lasted less than 15 minutes. During the briefing, she called on only three reporters, all from conservative outlets, and spent a significant portion discussing President Trump's achievements.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Suspends Flights Following Houthi Missile Attacks on Riyadh Airport
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia has suspended all flights to and from King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh until next Saturday due to a series of Houthi missile attacks. The latest attack resulted in at least 13 fatalities and numerous injuries, prompting heightened security concerns. CCTV footage captured the moment of the missile strike, which has raised questions about the effectiveness of the country's defenses against such threats.

stories.title: Fatal Incident on Six Flags Roller Coaster Leads to Ride Closures
stories.summary: A man named Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem was killed after being ejected from the 'Goliath' roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia. He reportedly struck other patrons during his fall before landing below. Following this incident, Six Flags announced the temporary closure of nine other roller coasters across its parks in North America as a precautionary measure. The incident is currently under investigation.

stories.title: Russia Attacks Ukrainian Energy Facilities Amid Ceasefire Claims
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported that Russia has targeted at least six energy facilities in Ukraine, contradicting claims made by US President Donald Trump of an 'energy ceasefire' agreement between the two nations. The strikes occurred shortly after Trump's announcement, which stated that both sides would refrain from attacking energy infrastructure. Zelenskyy emphasized that Russia is not honoring this ceasefire.

stories.title: Joseph Kabila Forms New Political-Military Coalition in DR Congo
stories.summary: Former DR Congo President Joseph Kabila has announced the formation of a new political-military coalition called the Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN). This coalition includes key figures from the previously established AFC/M23 group, which has been associated with anti-government forces. Analysts suggest that Kabila's involvement could significantly alter the political landscape and opposition dynamics against President Felix Tshisekedi.
